title: 面向电信客服的合成孟加拉语语音资源构建与评估
summary: 该论文介绍了一个用于电信客服场景的合成孟加拉语语音数据集，包含10,000对音频-文本，约26.82小时24kHz语音，并公开于Hugging Face（CC-BY-4.0）。使用OmniVoice语音克隆生成，提供标准化转录文本。通过Whisper ASR评估，平均WER为2.54%，CER为0.59%，显示良好的文本-音频一致性，同时讨论了合成语音和STT评估的局限性。
summary_en: This paper presents a synthetic Bengali speech dataset for telecom customer care, containing 10,000 audio-text pairs (~26.82 hours) generated with OmniVoice, publicly released on Hugging Face. Evaluated with Whisper ASR, achieving average WER 2.54% and CER 0.59%, indicating strong text-audio consistency, while discussing limitations of synthetic speech and STT evaluation.
